content.content:
1202014 Hopefully a (perhaps temporary) fix for the synthetic stack bug.
2f1243e Add a `with(MetadataKey<Boolean>)` method to set a boolean metadata flag.
0805f96 Explicitly allow logVarargs to take an array containing null objects.
91d4388 Adding "callerOf(Class<?>)" to LogSites to allow simpler APIs for logging utilities.
385a584 Rollback
c1759fc Adding "callerOf(Class<?>)" to LogSites to allow simpler APIs for logging utilities.
8a5b885 Roll forward after fixing the rollback issue.
71f6083 Promoting with() method to public FluentLogger since it's starting to be useful outside of GoogleLogger (there's a thread in open source where I just recommended it to someone forgetting that it's not public).
ac95fe8 Attempting to clarify docs around how the special "literal message" string marker is used.
05e7c8b Expose if logger.log(lazy()) is used so that these args can be filtered out.
1b447d1 Adding a way to explicitly get the logSite information and loosening up the withInjectedLogSite() call to permit users to call it (with docs explaining why). This is a neat way to solve a lot of the cases where people were splitting the logging API out.
74ff562 Adding a new enum to suppress stack creation when it's conditional. In theory this could also use null, but it's a special case so it shouldn't be easy to hit accidentally.
02a5f3f Remove the skip parameter from the synthetic stack trace method and update docs on the other method that does take a skip parameter.
54cd0d9 Refactoring platform structure to allow a non-Google platform to be configured via system properties. Also made GooglePlatform no longer subclass DefaultPlatform since that had no real benefit in the design.
229fbca Convert Metadata.EMPTY to a static method
d2250ab Add pom file generation to Flogger
e89571d Initial Flogger code

The commit 02a5f3f introduced the exact bug, and the fix commit's diff/comments directly reference and reverse it (the removed comment in the fix matches word-for-word the comment added in 02a5f3f explaining why skip was removed).

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 02a5f3fff3110cdf2fc8e1770e2cc238efa36dff

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** I traced the git history of `CallerFinder.java` (the file most substantively changed in the fix). The fix commit's diff removes a comment block from the `getStackForCallerOf` loop stating: *"Note that previous versions of this code skipped some variable number of stack frames... Now we just start at the immediate 'parent' frame,"* and replaces `for (int index = 0; ...)` with `for (int index = skip; ...)`. This strongly suggested a prior commit had removed a `skip` parameter and hardcoded the loop to start at 0. Searching the file's log turned up `02a5f3f`, whose message is literally "Remove the skip parameter from the synthetic stack trace method..."

**(2) Specific change:** Commit `02a5f3f` removed the `skip` parameter from `getStackForCallerOf(Class<?>, Throwable, int, int)`, added the exact comment that the fix commit later deletes, and changed the loop from `for (int index = skip; ...)` to `for (int index = 0; ...)`. This meant the method could no longer skip any of its own internal stack frames (e.g., frames from `postProcess`/`shouldLog`/overridden subclass methods) before searching for the caller of `LogContext`. If a subclass overrides `postProcess` (calling super), the loop could match the wrong frame or start scanning too early, producing an incorrect/synthetic stack trace — exactly the "synthetic stack bug" the fix commit's title references.

**(3) Supporting evidence:** The fix commit re-adds a `skip` parameter to `getStackForCallerOf` (restoring the pre-02a5f3f signature shape), changes the loop back to `for (int index = skip; ...)`, and updates `LogContext.java` to explicitly pass `skip = 1` with a new comment explaining that skipping is "essential for correctness" specifically because `postProcess()` can be overridden — directly addressing the regression introduced when the skip logic was removed. The removed/re-added comment text is nearly identical between the two commits, confirming this is a direct revert-and-fix of the change made in `02a5f3f`.

I'm confident in this identification — the fix is essentially reverting 02a5f3f's core logic change while re-adding docs/validation, and the commit messages/comments align precisely.
